subject: Price queue rapid clearance — FlightPath forecast risk
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Price queue rapid clearance — FlightPath forecast risk

Team,

Heads-up: FlightPath Analytics (FP-3921) is pressing to close this week. Procurement just countered our proposal asking for an additional 10% off list (on top of the 10% we already showed) and said the CFO will walk if they don’t get it by COB Friday. This is currently in our forecast as a commit for Q3 and losing it would be a noticeable hole (~$220k ARR).

Quick data:
- Proposed ACV (net of the 10% we already showed): $1,100,000
- Procurement ask: additional 10% (net of current proposal) for a 12‑month term
- Close target: 2027-06-25 (customer insists)
- HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/contacts/FP-3921

Options I'm asking Deal Desk + Finance to triage quickly:
1) Approve the extra 10% as a discount (fastest) — needs Finance sign-off for economics.
2) Offer a one-time onboarding credit tied to milestone payments (keeps list intact but reduces first year cash).
3) Ask customer to extend close by 1 week to run a normal approval/escrow flow.

Attachments: pricing-matrix.xlsx (latest), FlightPath_SOW_v2.pdf

Ask: Can Deal Desk and Finance give a directional decision by EOD tomorrow so I can lock the commit in the forecast? If approval requires a specific structure (credit vs discount), please call that out and paste the language we should send to FlightPath.

Thanks — I can hop on a 15-min call any time today.

— Soojin
Account Exec, SMB
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Price queue rapid clearance — FlightPath forecast risk

Sooj,

Saw this — I'm pulling together a quick economics view. Two quick asks:
1) Can you confirm expected first-year cash (we should know ARR vs cash-flow impact)?
2) Any wiggle on term length? 12 months vs 24 months changes the math a bunch.

Preliminary thought: approving the full 10% discount hurts margin materially. If Finance is comfortable, we can do a one-time onboarding credit equal to ~8% of ACV and keep list price intact; that usually clears procurement and is easier to reconcile in revenue recognition. Attached a short CSV with a few scenarios (deal-economics.csv).

If customer is insistent on a percentage off list, call me and I’ll run it through Deal Desk escalation — we'll need Finance sign-off either way.

— Karthik
Sr. Deal Desk Manager

From: Quinn Harper <quinn@flightpath.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@flightpath.ai
Date: 2027-06-18T12:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Price queue rapid clearance — FlightPath forecast risk

Soojin,

Appreciate the heads-up. The CFO is on a hard deadline; if we don't have a firm number by Friday they will pause. We prefer a simple list discount but will consider a credit if it accomplishes the same net; it must be reflected in our signed SOW. I've attached an updated SOW with Procurement comments (FlightPath_SOW_v2.pdf).

Can you let me know the best-case and fallback options today so we can review internally? We are ready to sign as soon as the language is finalized.

— Quinn
Head of Procurement
FlightPath Analytics

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-18T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Price queue rapid clearance — FlightPath forecast risk

Soojin/Karthik,

I pulled the scenario. Finance can approve a commercial concession structured as a one-time onboarding credit up to 8% of ACV, provided:
- It is documented as a one-time, non-recurring credit in the SOW (not a list discount).
- Accounting will require a short memo tying the credit to onboarding milestones for revenue recognition.

If sales still prefers an outright list discount, we need a formal economics waiver (I can route) and it will require a second-level approval which will likely miss the Friday deadline. For speed, the one-time credit is the path of least resistance.

DocuSign prep: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/xxxxx-approval

If everyone agrees to the credit structure, Karthik — please provide the credit language I can paste into the SOW and I'll get DocuSign ready. I'll confirm sign-off as soon as the final SOW version lands in my inbox.

— Vanessa
Director, Revenue Finance

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Quinn Harper <quinn@flightpath.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-19T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Final: FlightPath — approved structure & forecast update

Quinn / team,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. To summarize and confirm our mutual path:

- Redwood will provide a one-time onboarding credit equal to 8% of ACV (applied as a credit against the first invoice). This is non-recurring and will be documented in the SOW.
- Accounting/Finance (Vanessa) has approved the credit structure and will sign once the SOW includes the credit language below.

Credit language to paste into SOW (approved):
"Redwood will apply a one-time onboarding credit equal to 8% of the total annual contract value (ACV). This credit will be applied to the first invoice and is non-recurring. The parties agree that this credit is a commercial concession for onboarding and does not alter the underlying list pricing or renewal pricing for subsequent terms."

Please confirm you accept that language and we'll route the SOW via DocuSign (Vanessa has the link). For CRM hygiene, please update the opportunity stage to "Commit — Finance Approved" and keep the close date 2027-06-25. HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/contacts/FP-3921

I'll mark the forecast as committed once I see the signed SOW. Thanks team — appreciate the rapid clearance.

Attachments: final_SOW_with_credit_placeholder.pdf (will be uploaded to DocuSign)

— Soojin
Account Exec, SMB
Redwood Inference
